title: Bound on the Initial State
statement: Let $k,S,p,B$ be natural numbers. If $k\le B$, $S\le B$, and $p\le B$, then the state with depth $k$, stack value $S$, input pointer $p$, and all four scratch registers equal to $0$ has every register at most $B$.
